prompt: On a bustling train station platform, thick impasto brushstrokes capture the movement of travelers. In the center, an elderly man in a tweed coat checks his pocket watch while standing next to a large leather suitcase. To his left, a young woman in a red scarf waves goodbye to a soldier in uniform who is boarding a steam train emitting billowing white smoke. A porter in a blue cap carries three stacked trunks toward the train car, straining under the weight. On the right, a child in a striped shirt feeds crumbs to a pigeon perched on a wooden bench. Behind them, a newsstand vendor hands a newspaper to a businessman in a suit reading the headlines. A clock tower looms in the background, its face partially obscured by steam. The lighting is dramatic, with shafts of light piercing through the smoky haze, illuminating dust motes in the air. Colors are rich and saturated, with deep blues, warm browns, and vibrant reds contrasting against the gray steel of the trains. The texture of the paint is visible, adding a tactile quality to the scene. This composition is rendered in the style of an oil painting, emphasizing emotional resonance and atmospheric depth over precise photographic detail.
